import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static ArrayList<Integer> base_digits = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>>> base_matrix = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>>> precomputed_prefix = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>>> precomputed_suffix = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> global_trans;
    static long final_answer;

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> multiply_matrices(ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> A, ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> B) {
        int n = A.size();
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> C = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            ArrayList<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            C.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                if (A.get(i).get(k) != 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                        long val = (C.get(i).get(j) + A.get(i).get(k) * B.get(k).get(j)) % MOD;
                        C.get(i).set(j, val);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return C;
    }

    static ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> cyclic_shift(ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> input, int shift_amount) {
        int n = input.size();
        ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> output = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            ArrayList<Long> row = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                row.add(0L);
            }
            output.add(row);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (input.get(i).get(j) != 0) {
                    if (i == j) {
                        output.get(i).set(j, input.get(i).get(j));
                    } else {
                        output.get(i).set((j + shift_amount) % (int)K, input.get(i).get(j));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return output;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        N = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
        K = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());

        while (N > 0) {
            base_digits.add((int)(N % K));
            N /= K;
        }

        // Initialize base_matrix with dimensions [60][30]
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; ++i) {
            base_matrix.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j) {
                base_matrix.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        // Initialize precomputed_prefix and precomputed_suffix
        for (int i = 0; i < 60; ++i) {
            precomputed_prefix.add(new ArrayList<>());
            precomputed_suffix.add(new ArrayList<>());
            for (int j = 0; j < 30; ++j) {
                precomputed_prefix.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
                precomputed_suffix.get(i).add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
        }

        for (int idx = 0; idx < K; ++idx) {
            int size = (int)K + 1;
            ArrayList<ArrayList<Long>> matrix = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row) {
                ArrayList<Long> rowList = new ArrayList<>();
                for (int col = 0; col <= K; ++col) {
                    rowList.add(0L);
                }
                matrix.add(rowList);
            }
            for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row) {
                matrix.get(row).set(row, 1L);
            }
            for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row) {
                matrix.get(row).set(idx, 1L);
            }
            base_matrix.get(0).set(idx, matrix);
        }

        for (int level = 1; level < base_digits.size(); ++level) {
            precomputed_prefix.get(level - 1).set(0, base_matrix.get(level - 1).get(0));
            for (int col = 1; col < K; ++col) {
                precomputed_prefix.get(level - 1).set(col, multiply_matrices(precomputed_prefix.get(level - 1).get(col - 1), base_matrix.get(level - 1).get(col)));
            }

            precomputed_suffix.get(level - 1).set((int)K - 1, base_matrix.get(level - 1).get((int)K - 1));
            for (int col = (int)K - 2; col >= 0; --col) {
                precomputed_suffix.get(level - 1).set(col, multiply_matrices(base_matrix.get(level - 1).get(col), precomputed_suffix.get(level - 1).get(col + 1)));
            }

            base_matrix.get(level).set(0, precomputed_prefix.get(level - 1).get((int)K - 1));
            for (int col = 1; col < K; ++col) {
                base_matrix.get(level).set(col, multiply_matrices(precomputed_suffix.get(level - 1).get(col), precomputed_prefix.get(level - 1).get(col - 1)));
            }
        }

        global_trans = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row) {
            ArrayList<Long> rowList = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int col = 0; col <= K; ++col) {
                rowList.add(0L);
            }
            global_trans.add(rowList);
        }
        for (int row = 0; row <= K; ++row) {
            global_trans.get(row).set(row, 1L);
        }

        int cumulative_sum = 0;
        for (int pos = base_digits.size() - 1; pos >= 0; --pos) {
            int digit_val = base_digits.get(pos);
            for (int step = 0; step < digit_val; ++step) {
                global_trans = multiply_matrices(global_trans, base_matrix.get(pos).get(cumulative_sum));
                cumulative_sum++;
                if (cumulative_sum >= K) cumulative_sum -= K;
            }
        }

        final_answer = 1;
        for (int col = 0; col < K; ++col) {
            final_answer = (final_answer + global_trans.get((int)K).get(col)) % MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(final_answer);
    }
}
